_season_note: Issue 20 (Standard Weekly) is week 2 of the In Practice season 'Technical strategy under uncertainty' (Ferit Topcu / Zenjob, via LeadDev). Outside In RETURNS at Issue 20 after the Issue 19 omission - Shopify (Zack Deveau), a company new to outside_in_history; Shopify could not serve both In Practice and Outside In, so Zenjob took In Practice and kept long-form AI variety at 1 of 3. Leadership Read primary HELD (the authorised paywall fallback did not fire). The Lead repeats Issue 19's operational concern (Operating at scale) - a deliberate, documented call under the v3.4 soft breadth guardrail (rolling-4 spread is 3 of 4 concerns); note SKILL.md's State Tracking section still carries a legacy 'lead must differ from last_lead_topic' line that the spec retired at v3.4. Binding facts carried forward: no shared cause was ever published for the 27 July UK multi-bank degradation - simultaneity is documented, causation is not, and it must not be upgraded in later coverage; Faster Payments the rail did NOT fail. The 'July 2026 AWS mega-outage' remains UNVERIFIED and was demoted for a third consecutive issue - only the 24 July us-west-2 routing event is asserted, and it must not be conflated with the standing us-east-1 concentration watch. AWS ME-CENTRAL-1 / ME-SOUTH-1 remain OPEN on the AWS Health Dashboard with AWS's last public update dated 30 April 2026. The agentic-payments deep-dive cluster stays retired. Issue 20 shipped 12 pages / ~3,600 words against the spec's nominal 5-7 page limit - Phase 5 judged the limit arithmetically unreachable against current section floors (issues 11-18 all ran 9-13 pages) and recommended amending the spec to a 2,800-3,600 word budget. That spec amendment is NOT yet made.
